stage1.impression: A strong idea that reads at once: a glowing amber speaker standing in a rain-swept black lava plain, its reflection running down a puddle toward the lens. The mood and the reflection work, but it still reads as CG. The product is lit evenly from the front like a studio packshot while the sun sits behind it, the lava reads as soft lumpy dough rather than rock, the splash crowns are oversized bright sprites clustered in the puddle, and the brightest thing in the frame is a flat, featureless horizon band rather than the product.

blocking_9: The speaker's lighting must agree with a low back sun: brighter rim and top edges, a front face that falls off left to right, not a flat even front fill
The ground must read as wet basalt at real scale: sharp fractured edges, vesicles and fine grit, no rounded, smoothed pillow blobs
Splash crowns must read as tiny, short-lived water events at 1/60 s (a few mm, faint), not bright glassy cups 15 to 30 px wide
A visible contact shadow and occlusion in the water under and around the cabinet and its feet
The horizon band must not be the brightest area in the frame; it needs atmospheric gradation and depth, not a flat bright strip with a thin ridge
The sky must read as a storm: darker cloud deck at the top, with the light breaking low behind the speaker

defects.what: Front face evenly front-lit (bins 106-131 across the lit areas) though the sun is behind; reads studio-clean in a natural scene
Near-left lava forms read as smooth rounded dough lumps with soft specular, no fracture or grain at real scale
Right ground the same blobby forms, repeating pattern of similar lumps
Splash crowns oversized (15-35 px), bright and glassy, clustered in the puddle; read as particle sprites
Weak contact: luminance step only -8 under the cabinet; water under it is as lit as the open puddle, so the cabinet looks set down on spikes over a plate
Horizon band is the brightest region (median 196 vs product 104); flat, featureless, pulls the eye off the product
Thin ridge on the left horizon reads as a pasted-on silhouette, too crisp for 200 m through rain
Top of sky at median 151: too light for a storm deck; frame lacks top-down weight
Rain streaks are uniform in length and brightness, evenly scattered, several long bright verticals read as drawn lines
Horn interior shows a dark rotor-like reflection shape that reads as a CG reflection artefact rather than the horn's throat

changes.problem: The speaker is lit flat from the front by fill cards, disagreeing with a sun behind and to the right, so it looks pasted in.

evidence.measured: x-profile of the lit faces 124.6/131.2/109.8/106.3 ... 106.6/114.6: left and right equally bright, no falloff away from the sun

change.setting: Lamps: 2 m reflector at 40 deg left (irradiance 4.0); low front card on the lower half (1.5); rim card behind right (9.0)
change.from: reflector 4.0, low front card 1.5, rim card 9.0
change.to: reflector 1.8, remove the low front card, rim card 14.0 and raise it to 0.8 of the cabinet height so it also catches the top edge

changes.expected: Right edge and top edge glow, left of the front face falls 30-40 % below the right; product median drops slightly while its p95 rises

changes.problem: The modelled lava pillows and ropes read as rounded dough, not wet basalt.

evidence.measured: Crop shows smooth rounded lumps with soft broad highlights; range only 43.6 over 100-800 x 1000-1250

change.setting: Ground: modelled lava forms and texture
change.from: pillows and ropes, grain 9 m to 12 cm, bump 3.0, displacement 7 cm
change.to: drop the pillow and rope forms within 12 m of the camera; replace with fractured slab and clinker shapes (sharp edges, 2-15 cm scale), add a 5 mm vesicle/grit layer, bump 1.5 on a 0.4 m tile, displacement 3 cm

changes.expected: Near ground shows sharp breaks and fine pitted detail with small crisp wet glints instead of broad soft sheen

changes.problem: The splash crowns are oversized, bright glass cups that read as particles.

evidence.measured: Crowns 15-35 px wide and highlights near 230 in the crop; at 9 m with an 80 mm lens 20 mm is about 6 px

change.from: 700 crowns 2 to 20 mm at opacity 0.15; 900 at 3 to 10 m, 2 to 12 mm, 0.1
change.to: 700 crowns 2 to 8 mm at opacity 0.08 with roughness 0.15; 900 at 3 to 10 m, 2 to 6 mm, 0.05; let the ripple rings carry the rain

changes.expected: Puddle reads as rippled water with faint pinpricks; reflection of the speaker becomes the dominant element

changes.problem: The horizon band is the brightest area in the frame and flat, pulling the eye off the product.

change.to: haze 0.004 /m to 400 m with colour #8E9468, sky strength 0.10; keep sun lamp 10.0

changes.expected: Horizon softened and darker, ridge melts into the haze, the band gradates rather than sits as a strip

changes.problem: The sky has no storm weight at the top.

evidence.measured: median 150.8, almost as bright as the sky mid band (162)

change.setting: Finish: vignette, plus a graduated filter
change.to: vignette 0.18 and a top graduated darken of -0.6 EV from the top edge to y = 500

changes.expected: Dark cloud deck over the frame, light breaking low behind the speaker

changes.problem: The cabinet has almost no contact shadow; the water under it is as lit as the open puddle.

evidence.measured: edge step -8, width 12 px; region 1000-1400 x 1210-1240 median 42 but open puddle beside is 79-105

change.setting: Speaker standing depth and the low front card
change.from: 2 cm deep, low front card lights the lower half
change.to: 4 cm deep in a shallower hollow so the plinth meets water across its width; with c1 the front card is removed, so the water under the cabinet goes into its own shade

changes.expected: A dark band of occlusion in the water directly under and just in front of the cabinet

changes.problem: The rain streaks are uniform and a few long bright verticals read as drawn lines.

evidence.measured: Visible streaks of similar length and brightness evenly scattered; a few full-length bright lines left of the speaker

change.to: 100,000 streaks, opacity 0.06 to 0.3 with only those within 15 deg of the sun direction above 0.2, 6 to 14 cm; add 20 % density clumping in 3 m cells

changes.expected: Rain reads as backlit sheets that sparkle toward the sun, quieter elsewhere

changes.problem: The thin ridge on the left horizon is a crisp silhouette that looks pasted in.

evidence.measured: Hard dark-on-bright edge at 200 m through rain

change.from: 3.5 m high at 200 m, left of the horizon
change.to: remove it, or move to 450 m and lengthen across 60 % of the horizon so the haze in c4 takes it

changes.expected: No single feature on the horizon competing with the horn

out_of_scope.request: The horn's interior shows a dark rotor-shaped reflection that reads as an artefact
out_of_scope.why: It is the speaker's horn and throat; only its lighting (the throat card, 0.5) may change, its shape may not

out_of_scope.request: The cabinet stands on spikes on discs, making it look lifted off the water
out_of_scope.why: The feet are part of the product
